items.stem: What is the key difference between energy efficiency and energy conservation?

options.text: Efficiency delivers the same service with less energy; conservation reduces the service or usage itself
options.rationale: Efficiency is doing the same with less input; conservation is using less of the service.

options.text: They are identical terms with no distinction
options.rationale: They describe different approaches to reducing energy use.

options.text: Conservation always costs more than efficiency
options.rationale: Cost is not what defines the distinction.
Efficiency applies across all end uses.

items.explanation: Efficiency is doing the same with less input; conservation is using less of the service.

items.stem: Which TWO measures would a structured energy audit rely on to prioritise savings? (Select TWO.)

options.text: A measured baseline of current consumption
options.rationale: A baseline lets savings be quantified and prioritised.

options.text: Cost of saved energy for each candidate measure
options.rationale: Ranking by cost of saved energy targets the best value first.

options.text: The colour of the building's exterior
options.rationale: Exterior colour is not an audit input for prioritisation.

options.text: The number of staff who prefer a measure
options.rationale: Preference is not a basis for prioritising energy savings.

items.explanation: A baseline lets savings be quantified and prioritised.
